ai_summary: Adani Energy Solutions (AESL) announced a significant improvement in its S&P Global ESG score, reaching 90 out of 100 to become the world's #1 ESG-scored utility, a substantial increase from its prior score of 81. This enhancement was primarily driven by a "correction" in a previously "impacted" governance-related assessment, positively impacting the company's reputation and potential access to ESG-focused capital. However, the reliance on a governance "correction" for such a dramatic score change might invite further scrutiny into the initial assessment's basis or the nature of the issue resolved.
